newsitem.title: USA: Montana Power files $150 mln note shelf.
newsitem.headline: Montana Power files $150 mln note shelf.

text.p: Montana Power Co said Tuesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $150 million in medium-term notes, series B.

The Butte-based company said each note will mature from nine months to 40 years from its date of issue. The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co, J.P. Morgan & Co, Lehman Brothers and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc.
Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including the redemption, repayment or retirement of debt, company, the filing said.
Montana Power's principal business is its electric and natural gas utility operation.
